latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Face Swap Video AI.

- Instantly swap faces in videos by uploading video clips (up to 500MB) and describing the swap you want.
- Supports MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM inputs; outputs 1080p MP4 videos.
- Automatic setup with anonymous token (100 free credits for 7 days).
- Fast cloud rendering: get results in 30–90 seconds for typical clips.
- Simple commands for upload, export, checking credits, and workflow management.
- Designed for content creators who want fast, easy face swaps without complex editing.
